Let us join in a cohort,
i made this arrangement of the Italian national anthem because around musescore i could'nt see any
arrangement made fo wind band. so i made one. i was inspired by someone arrangement (i don't remember
who was the author of that arrangement) and i arranged the anthem for this kind of wind band.
there is a Piccolo, Two flutes, one Clarinet, two Alto sax, one Tenor Sax, one Baritone Sax, Bass Drum,
Snare Drum and Cymbals. in this arrangement i've inserted even a choir, wich is divided by females
(the upper part) and males (the lower part) i hope you can understand the words as i wroted
if there is anything wrong you can email me at fabio.allori@gmail.com so i can check and correct.
please make sure before modify this arrangement tell me.
